auditor_jane: Hi team — follow-up from the SOC2 audit. Can you provide exports of API auth failures, KMS/HSM errors, and any related billing/anomaly traces for org `acme-inc` from 2024-08-01 to 2024-09-30? Need raw logs + rotation artifacts (key manifests, who rotated, timestamps). Also need repro steps for any auth failures that correlate with cost spikes.

maria_sec: Thanks — clarifying q: raw logs or a summarized evidence packet? Do you need full HSM rotation logs or just rotation manifest?

auditor_jane: Raw logs preferred. Rotation manifest + chain-of-custody for keys is required. For repro, a minimal step-by-step that triggers the auth failure is fine.

alan_support: I can pull a filtered export (org_id=acme-inc, events=(auth_failure,kms_error,api_429)) and put on s3. Will obfuscate tokens and include object hash + signed manifest.

jake_eng: FYI there was an internal incident on 2024-08-22 where a KMS rotation overlapped with a runtime deploy; should be in those timestamps. Quick internal query we used: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $LOG_TOKEN\" 'https://logs.internal.redwood/v1/query?from=2024-08-01T00:00:00Z&to=2024-09-30T23:59:59Z&q=org_id:acme-inc AND (event:auth_failure OR event:kms_error OR event:billing_anomaly)'`

sree_ops: Note for large exports: we'll compress and upload to `s3://redwood-evidence/exports/` and attach a manifest at `s3://redwood-evidence/manifests/`. Rotation artifacts live in Vault (path `kv/rotations/acme-inc/2024-08-22`), access controlled. Also: retention policy is the standard 3 years for audit logs.

auditor_jane: Can you confirm whether any sampling was applied to the logs? Auditor needs proof there's no selective sampling for this export, plus a hash and signed manifest for chain-of-custody.

maria_sec: No sampling applied for this export :thumbsup:. We'll include: export manifest, SHA256 hash, GPG signature, and a link to the retention policy doc (internal). Also will include rotation manifest showing key id, rotation timestamp, and operator.

alan_support: Starting export job now (filter: org_id=acme-inc, event_types=[auth_failure,kms_error,api_429], time_range=2024-08-01..2024-09-30). ETA ~2 hours. Will redact tokens and IPs as per PII policy, but will keep key ids and error reasons.

compliance-bot: Export job 8792 initiated by alan_support — target: `s3://redwood-evidence/exports/1923456789-acme-aug-sep-logs.gz`

alan_support: Upload complete. Presigned link (expires 7d): https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-evidence/exports/1923456789-acme-aug-sep-logs.gz?X-Amz-Signature=EXAMPLE. SHA256: 3f6a8b9c... GPG sig attached at s3://redwood-evidence/signatures/1923456789-acme.sig

jake_eng: Repro steps (keeps minimal infra commands):
1) Rotate key: `kms rotate-key --alias alias/acme-prod --region us-west-2`
2) Deploy runtime commit `a1b2c3` to inference-runtime (staged canary)
3) Run load test: `hey -c 50 -q 2000 https://api.redwood.ai/v1/serve`
4) Observe metrics: auth failures and KMS errors spike for ~5–20m as cached clients try old key id
Logs example (sanitized):
```
[2024-08-22T14:03:12Z] org=acme-inc event=kms_error key=alias/acme-prod err=invalid_key_version
[2024-08-22T14:03:18Z] org=acme-inc event=auth_failure reason=stale_key_id client=svc-123
```

auditor_jane: Perfect — I'll review the export and the repro steps. Please also add a 2–3 sentence root cause + mitigation summary for the evidence packet.

maria_sec: Root cause summary (to include in packet): overlapping KMS rotation and runtime deploy caused stale key ids in cached clients; mitigation: staged rotation + cache invalidation script + rollout window. Will attach runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/key-rotation

alan_support: Attached manifest and added a README explaining redaction and chain-of-custody. If auditors need an expanded time range or different filters (region=eu-west-1), say so and I'll run another export.

auditor_jane: This is great — thanks team. If possible, can you also provide a short timeline of who rotated the key (operator id) and the rotation ticket ID? Auditor requested operator attribution.

maria_sec: Operator attribution and ticket ID included in Vault rotation manifest. I'll export a sanitized copy into the evidence bundle and note access control.

auditor_jane: Closing loop for now — I'll follow up after review. Thanks :heart:
